glossary.definition: (F) As used in this section, "registering a voter" and "registering voters" includes any effort, for compensation, to provide voter registration forms or to assist persons in completing or returning those forms.
glossary.source_title: Section 3503.29 - Training and registration of compensated voter registrants.
